IdeaRecord Navbar order, including any local or saved Spaces placed in the navbar.
 Omitted system tabs keep their saved place; Chat is always first.
 Both lists are required. Their combined limit, including Chat, is 500. Order below the navbar divider. System tabs except Chat and local or saved Spaces
 may appear here.
 Creation and promotion prepend to this list.^(system|space|saved_space|peer_space)$ Either list accepts system destinations and promoted local or saved Spaces;
 Chat stays first in navbar. Stable navigation item_key, never a display title. System keys are chat,
 feed, ideas, goals, library, and, while the peer gate is on,
 connections. The Space's immutable UUID. The Space's name as the invitation signs it, for previews; null when
 empty. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the Space's icon as a JPEG, as the
 invitation signs it; omitted when it carries no icon. Before the
 owner accepts, fetch the bytes from Hatch's public
 `/api/hatch/peer-invite-photos/{icon_sha256}` and show them only
 when they hash to this value. This owner holds a live share of exactly this Space now. Where this owner's acceptance stands: `pending` (not accepted yet, or
 accepted and still on its way), `granted`, or `unavailable` (it will
 not come; see `unavailable_reason`). Only the host's answer or the
 relationship ending makes it `unavailable`, never time. Set when `state` is `unavailable`: from the host's answer to this
 owner's claim, `space_unavailable` (deleted or re-created since the
 invitation), `claimed_by_other`, `expired`, `revoked` or `refused`;
 `unshared` when the host later unshared it; `relationship_ended` when
 the relationship the acceptance belongs to is gone. The exact Space a verified space-only invitation names, as owner clients
 read it: on the invitation routes and on `space_invitation_received`
 Connections activity rows. It says where to go, never what is allowed:
 open it only once `granted`, or once the catalog holds
